verdict.rationale: LM Studio's docs confirm native Apple Silicon acceleration via Apple MLX alongside llama.cpp (lm-studio-docs-29), and a community post praises it as 'the best way to run local LLMs on an Apple Silicon Mac' once MLX support landed (lm-studio-comm-12). However, another hands-on report directly contradicts this, stating the same models 'ran MUCH slower in LM Studio than in Ollama on a MacBook Air M1 2020' (lm-studio-comm-6), a concrete counter-example to the accelerated-inference claim. Missing for 10: first-party benchmarks quantifying Metal/MLX speedups, resolution of the conflicting performance report, and broader independent corroboration beyond one blog mention and mixed anecdotes.
